decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the demolition of the existing house and the erection of a three storey three bedroom dwelling house would not be detrimental to the character and appearance of the 'The Butts' Conservation Area or of the adjoining listed building. Moreover, the proposal will not adversely affect the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV. B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and B.2.5 (Development Affecting the Setting of Listed Building) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan adopted December 2003.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - The building, the subject of this consent, shall not be demolished before planning permission has been granted for the redevelopment of the site and a contract for the carrying out of work of redevelopment of the site has been let.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of brick work and gauged brick arches showing the colour texture face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved

Condition : 6 - Details (samples where appropriate) of the following at scale 1:5 (or as appropriate) to include sections of:

a)	All new windows and doors 
b)	The new glazed element to the front roof
c)	Rubbed and gauged brick arches
d)	Metal glazed element to the rear
e)	Lead clad roof

Shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
description: Demolition of existing building and erection of a three storey three bedroom house.
